S7 Classes for Type Metadata

Source: R/type-metadata.R
type-metadata.Rd

These classes provide a type-safe representation of type annotations extracted from @typedParam and @typedReturn tags. Using S7 classes instead of plain lists prevents common errors like typos in field names and ensures consistent structure across the codebase.

Details

Design Philosophy

rdoc uses S7 internally for all type metadata, practicing what it preaches. S7 objects are used throughout:

  • Internal type registry: S7 objects

  • Serialization (inst/types.rds): S7 objects (serialize perfectly with saveRDS)

  • Tests: Access S7 properties with @ operator

This provides type safety and validation while maintaining clean serialization.
